note: Deterministic workflows and read-only reports ONLY. No Cube-side LLM steps in the demo path — Ember is the only brain. Phase 3 read tools run through the Metatron MCP Bus (JSON-RPC tools/call), except list_connectors and get_asset which call SysOps directly (the MCP wrappers for those two are broken server-side: list_connectors crashes on the types dict, get_asset 404s on ref-format paths). Every read is a pure data fetch — no model runs. Approval tokens are injected by the orchestrator's approval step and are never shown to Ember. EXCLUDED from the MCP bus on purpose: create_ticket (triggers Axion auto-triage), knowledge_search (embedding model), ask_cube (calls Axion).

tools.description: List the approved deterministic workflows the orchestrator may call.
tools.name: list_workflows
tools.returns: Catalog of workflow ids, names, and required inputs.

tools.description: Read live Watcher status (components up/down, open incidents, host summary) from the AIOps console API. Read-only, deterministic.
tools.name: get_watcher_status
tools.returns: Component totals, open-incident count, recent incidents (trimmed), host summary, as one sanitised payload.

tools.description: Fire a deterministic webhook-triggered Activepieces flow. Requires a human approval token (injected by the approval step) — Ember proposes, a human approves, only then does this unlock.
tools.name: run_workflow

workflow_id.description: One of the catalog workflow ids that has a production flow.

tools.returns: Run id and status; results are read back via get_run_status.

tools.description: Poll the result of a fired workflow run.
tools.name: get_run_status
tools.returns: Run status and its deterministic result payload.

tools.description: File human-approved triaged help-desk tickets to the orchestrator board (deterministic local store; no AI). Each ticket carries Ember's classification, a draft reply, and a route. Requires a human approval token. Nothing is sent to requesters.
tools.name: file_tickets

draft_reply.description: Short draft reply to the requester. A draft only — a human approves before anything is sent.

id.description: Ticket id from the input, e.g. TKT-001.

route.description: Team or queue the ticket routes to.

tools.returns: Count filed, board total, and the filed ticket ids.

tools.description: Live estate status: components up/down, host vitals, open incidents. Read-only.
tools.name: cube_status
tools.returns: Component totals, down list, host summary, open-incident count.

tools.description: Capacity report: host saturation, disk-days-to-90 forecast, per-component 7-day uptime and latency. Read-only.
tools.name: capacity_report
tools.returns: Host current + forecast scalars; worst components first (capped).

tools.description: List CMDB assets (SysOps). Optional type filter and limit. Read-only.
tools.name: list_assets
tools.returns: Count plus capped asset list (ref, name, type, lifecycle).

tools.backend: SysOps direct (MCP wrapper 404s on ref paths); ref resolved to id via MCP list_assets
tools.description: Get one CMDB asset by ref (e.g. CI-0001) or numeric id, with relationships. Read-only.
tools.name: get_asset
tools.returns: Asset record plus depends/dependents (capped).

tools.description: Recent SysOps change-register entries. Optional limit. Read-only.
tools.name: list_changes
tools.returns: Count plus capped change entries (ref, kind, summary, status).

tools.description: List ITSM tickets (read-only; never creates). Optional status filter and limit.
tools.name: list_tickets
tools.returns: Count plus capped tickets (ref, title, status, priority, category).

tools.description: RCA and auto-heal records from ITSM. Read-only.
tools.name: list_rca
tools.returns: Capped RCA records (ref, component, status, policy, summary).

tools.description: SecOps posture: CVE/KEV/EPSS counts, top priority CVEs, estate totals. Read-only data; never investigates.
tools.name: secops_status
tools.returns: KPIs, source counts, estate totals, top 5 priority CVEs (trimmed).

tools.description: List dashboards from the Dashboard Generator. Read-only.
tools.name: list_dashboards
tools.returns: Capped dashboard list (slug, title, source kind, last refresh).

tools.description: List Metatron RPA (Activepieces) flows with status. Read-only.
tools.name: list_flows
tools.returns: Total + enabled counts, capped flow list (name, status).

tools.description: Which local brain is live (Axion/Qwen) and its state. Read-only.
tools.name: brain_status
tools.returns: Live brain name, switching flag, target.

tools.backend: SysOps direct (MCP wrapper crashes server-side on the types dict)
tools.description: CMDB connectors configured in SysOps and their status. Read-only.
tools.name: list_connectors
tools.returns: Connector list (name, type, status, has_credentials) plus known types.

tools.description: Search the KAG knowledge graph by label text. Read-only.
tools.name: graph_search
tools.returns: Capped matches (label, kind, ref).

tools.description: Blast radius: what depends transitively on a component slug (e.g. model-endpoint). Read-only.
tools.name: graph_dependents
tools.returns: Dependent count plus capped dependents (label, kind, ref).

tools.description: Failure predictions: per-component risk scores, bands, and reasons. Read-only.
tools.name: predictions
tools.returns: Risk max, high/watch counts, host risk, top risks (capped, worst first).

tools.description: FinOps summary: Cube run costs today/month/projected, budget %, alerts. Read-only.
tools.name: finops_summary
tools.returns: Costs, budget, alerts, usage counts, host balance days-left.

tools.description: Lease & Acquisition summary: pipeline, expiring/expired leases, rent totals. Read-only.
tools.name: list_leases
tools.returns: Pipeline by stage, totals, capped expiring/expired leases.

tools.description: ITSM sentiment summary: ticket counts by requester sentiment, frustrated users, escalation risk. Read-only.
tools.name: sentiment_summary
tools.returns: Counts by sentiment/risk, averages, capped frustrated tickets.

tools.description: FinClose DEMO month-end close KPIs (simulated data): revenue, margins, EBITDA, exceptions. Read-only.
tools.name: finclose_summary
tools.returns: Demo KPIs, close state, exception counts and capped exceptions.
